$comment: THE WARDROBE MANIFEST (build 25): the single source of truth for every piece of Bolo clothing. `node scripts/wardrobe.mjs codegen` regenerates the server catalogue table, mobile's literal require() maps and both clients' shop racks from this file; `gen`/`install` drive the compositing generators with each item's recorded recipe. Hand-edit THIS file, never the generated ones. The laws that bound every entry: the canonical mascot rule (she is never redrawn), the sleeve rule (wings redraw in front of cloth, so sleeved outerwear can never work; a Western jacket set was generated once and rejected - do not regenerate it), and eye clearance for anything on her head. costBand maps to server tokenEconomy constants: standard=OUTFIT_COST, premium=PREMIUM_OUTFIT_COST, accessory=ACCESSORY_COST.

A placed pose wins outright, so crown seating, the clearance lift and the old nudge overrides are all bypassed here.
